data.name: Trishaan
data.gender_notes: Trishaan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Trishaan is a name derived from the Hindu deity Rudra. It is believed to represent strength, loyalty, and victory. In Hindu mythology, Rudra is a god associated with destruction, chaos, and primal energy. The name Trishaan carries the meaning “God of Rudra” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Trishaan usually hope their child will grow to embody god of rudra and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Trishaan is a name that connects the bearer to the powerful and destructive energies of the Hindu deity Rudra. It is a name that embodies strength, loyalty, and the ability to overcome challenges and adversity.
data.etymology: Trishaan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Rudra.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Trishaan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Trishaan was the name of the third son of King Shibi of Haihayas Dynasty. He is famous for his kindness and sacrifice. Once he saved the life of a vulture by sacrificing his own flesh. This act of kindness and sacrifice was praised by the gods and Trishaan obtained the title of 'Mahapadma' or the Great Emperor.

Trishaan is also known as 'Thirushan' or 'Thiruvalluvar'. He was a famous Tamil poet and philosopher who lived during the early centuries CE. His works 'Thirukkural' is a collection of 1330 verses on various aspects of morality and ethics.
